text_block_list.text:
—The Kikuka Sho. The first GⅠ that Hishi 
Miracle ever set as a goal.

The place I was brought to before taking 
on that challenge was...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's draw a raffle ticket. A 
raffle ticket!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You know~, kinda like testing your luck, 
or maybe just escaping reality.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
When you hit a good one, it makes you feel 
like today's gonna be your day, right? 
Just like a TV horoscope.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Aries was ranked 10th on the morning 
show, so it wasn't looking great... That's 
why I'm making up for it right here!"

And so, I tried pulling from the Umamusume 
Lottery. The result was—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oho, it's a hit, a hit! Isn't this pretty 
incredible?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Manager, this is... super, ultra, 
mega-rare, isn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you won't win that often! There are 
only 3 winning sticks out of 8, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's in! Quite a bit of it is in, 
actually! 3/8th is pretty good!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. Let's just say you were 
moderately lucky, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Ah, my fortune's not bad at all!
Yeah, my fortune isn't bad at all!

text_block_list.text:
Riding on that momentum, we headed into 
Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, even though I did my good luck 
rituals, my heart feels so heavy~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho, huh~ I'm super happy that 
I get to run in it, but~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still feel kind of out of place, y'know? 
Can't quite get into that "risk it all to 
win!" mindset yet.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I really do lack 'resolve', don't I? 
Compared to Kris S and Gimlet, that is...

A lack of "resolve." That might certainly 
be true. However...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...That's true. While that is indeed the 
case, though.
choice_data_list:
So today will be a battle decided purely 
by effort.

So today will be a battle decided purely 
by effort.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A contest of pure "effort"... A battle of 
accumulated work with "resolve" having 
nothing to do with it... is that what you 
mean?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see. That's true... A GⅠ without those 
two super-insane runners...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If it's just about hard work, I've put in 
plenty too! It might not be enough, but 
I've earned the right to run.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I've got high expectations for you!
Yeah, I'm expecting great things from you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Yes!
(WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(The expectations and cheers... are heavy 
as always. It's not easy in the slightest. 
Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm not gonna break! I have to live 
up to these cheers!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm definitely gonna make it 
happen! —A miracle!!
